build_model_from_config: build a multimodal model instance from an OmegaConf DictConfig using the registered model class name
build_lightning_model_from_checkpoint: build a PyTorch Lightning model from a checkpoint path and config with distributed training support
build_optimizer_for_model: build an optimizer for a model from config supporting PyTorch optimizers or custom registered optimizer classes
build_dataloader_and_sampler: build a PyTorch DataLoader and DistributedSampler for a dataset with configurable workers and batch size
build_meters_for_run: build train, validation, and test Meter instances based on the specified run type string
